grades: Grades 6 to 12 for monthly service projects
duration: School year clubs; meetings last 30 minutes to 2 hours
name: YMCA Earth Service Corps
what_you_do: Join a youth-led environmental club at your school or start one. Take part in monthly service projects, a leaders summit, spring retreats and a spring environmental symposium.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 to 12. Clubs are school based. A map on the page shows partner schools, or you can ask to start a new club.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Events: Environmental Leaders Summit (the page says both winter and each fall), Eco-Retreats and Environmental Symposium (spring).
how_to_apply: Check the school map and join your school club, or email yesc@seattleymca.org to start one or join events. Teens can also volunteer as event support.
notes: The page says almost 1,500 young leaders took part in 2023-24. It does not give event dates for this year.
